title: BUGFIX — Pipeline Telegram notification shows qc_failed count but no failure detail
rationale: After Sprints 1362-1368 fixed QC checks, the operator has no visibility into whether QC is passing. The pipeline Telegram notification shows 'qc_failed: N' as a count only. When a video fails, the operator doesn't know which check failed (hook_timing? clip_understandable? why_does_this_matter?) and can't distinguish a systemic bug from a one-off. Fix: add qc_failures: string[] to PipelineRunReport.summary (failure_reason per failed gate), then show a QC section in notifier.ts when qc_failed > 0.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts: add qc_failures: string[] to PipelineRunReport.summary type and populate it from gates that failed (failure_reason or 'unknown'). In agents/scs001-orchestrator/notifier.ts: add a QC section showing pass/fail count and listing failure reasons when qc_failed > 0.
